cases.title: Record Visited Link to Global History
cases.description: Verify that when a link is visited, it is recorded to the Global History.

cases.title: Verify correct link recorded after server redirect
cases.description: Ensure that the correct link is recorded to the Global History after a server redirect occurs.

cases.title: Launch history link in browser window
cases.description: Verify that clicking on a history link causes it to be launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Delete a History entry
cases.description: Verify that a selected History entry is deleted successfully.

cases.title: Delete multiple history entries
cases.description: Select multiple History entries and delete them so they are no longer displayed.

cases.title: Clear Global History
cases.description: Verify that the Global History can be cleared successfully.

cases.title: Group history items by Day
cases.description: Verify that history items are grouped by Day.

cases.title: Group history items by Site
cases.description: Verify that history items are grouped by Site.

cases.title: Group history items by None
cases.description: Verify that history items are grouped by None.

cases.title: Sort and reverse-sort History per column
cases.description: Verify that History entries are sorted and reverse-sorted per column.

cases.title: Resize History Columns
cases.description: Verify that history columns are resizable to show or hide more of entries.

cases.title: Show History columns
cases.description: Verify that History columns can be shown.

cases.title: Hide History columns
cases.description: Verify that History columns can be hidden.

cases.title: Revisit recently visited sites via Back and Forward button dropdown menu
cases.description: Verify that recently visited sites can be re-visited using the dropdown menu of the Back and Forward buttons.

cases.title: Create empty session history file for new browser window or restart
cases.description: Verify that a new, empty session history file is created when a new browser window is opened or the browser is restarted.

opinions.feedback: All requirements have been thoroughly reviewed against the proposed test cases. Every explicitly described operation, sorting direction, grouping option, and state transition has a corresponding distinct test case covering it. No blockers or missing scenarios were found.
All requirements have corresponding test cases covering the explicitly described behaviors and states without any missing coverage gaps or blockers.
